registry.mandate: SPY and sector risk benchmarks; independent of research-2.0.0 direction
registry.historicalEvidence: Registered development benchmark on already observed history; no fresh historical holdout claim
registry.varianceTarget: mean of squared log first open-to-close leg and four subsequent close-to-close legs
registry.drawdownTarget: maximum peak-to-trough decline along entry price and five subsequent daily closes
registry.refitPolicy: calendar-month; actual first eligible publication in the launch month
registry.harEstimator: per-asset OLS log five-session target on log daily squared-return means; separate smearing calibration

garch.components: separate intraday and close-to-close fits; first intraday forecast plus close-to-close horizons 2 through 5

scoreGroups: nine sectors equally weighted within each date
registry.macroUse: Archived dated context only; no macro inputs in these benchmark model forecasts
registry.missingness: Keep exchange-session slots; stale or incomplete model inputs abstain. GARCH nonconvergence abstains for that model and month.
registry.promotion: No automatic winner, ensemble, trading policy or replacement of research-2.0.0. Future model changes require a new version and independent prospective evidence.
